pages.text: Ferment with $(item)Wine Yeast$(): red must makes $(item)red wine$() (Mild); white grape juice $(item)white wine$() and red grape juice $(item)rosé$() (Cool). Apple juice is $(item)cider$(), pear juice $(item)perry$().
Stir 2 honey bottles a bucket into a heated kettle of water for $(item)honey water$(): it ferments into $(item)mead$() (Mild). Every other fruit juice makes its own fruit wine, fermented Cool.
